summary: Digi Power X Inc. filed an 8-K to report a Data Center Colocation and Master Services Agreement with Cerebras Systems Inc. The agreement covers ~40 MW of AI computing capacity at the company's Alabama data center, with an initial 10-year term and extension options. Total contract value is ~$1.1 billion for the initial term, with potential ~$2.5 billion including a 7-year extension. Phase 1 (15 MW) targets December 2026, Phase 2 (25 MW) by Q1 2027, contingent on financing. This is a commercial services contract, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
